# BuffNook Tower — Site Index

BuffNook Tower is a free browser-based physics stacking game. No account, no download, no paywall.

## Structure

- `/` — Home page with the primary game (BuffNook Tower) and full article content
- `/games/buffnook-tower/` — BuffNook Tower game page (How to Play, Goal & Scoring, Tips, FAQ)
- `/about` — About the team and principles
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy (browser storage, analytics and advertising cookies)
- `/terms` — Terms of service
- `/disclaimer` — Disclaimer (independent site, no third-party affiliation)
- `/contact` — Email addresses for bugs, feedback, press

## Games

- **BuffNook Tower** — Stack 12 physics blocks on a seesaw, survive 5 buffs, decide when to bank. Daily UTC challenge + endless sandbox. Plays on desktop and mobile. URL: `/games/buffnook-tower/`

## Scoring

- Successful bank (lock): 100% of the current height
- Collapse during the 1.5s lock confirmation: 50% of the height
- Collapse before banking: 40% of the height

## Source of Truth

- `data/games.json` — authoritative game metadata
- `_templates/game.html` — game page template
- `_templates/page.html` — generic page template
- `scripts/build.mjs` — generates the game page and sitemap from data files

To add a new game: add one entry to `data/games.json`, drop the game bundle into `embed/<slug>/index.html`, then run `node scripts/build.mjs`.
